original_test_intent: Verify the Type 15 Access Method raw enum identifies the approved mechanism for exposing the System Event Log, is coherent with its Access Method Address and layout, and persists after reboot; this case does not exercise that mechanism.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 15 records, preserve the access enum, access-method address, layout/status/format and descriptors, compare the tuple to the approved event-log implementation and repeat after reboot without accessing raw log storage.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected access method/address semantics and reboot plan. Direct memory, indexed I/O or other advertised access is out of scope unless separately authorized.
required_inputs: Method-specific interpretation of Access Method Address
Platform log implementation and relationship to BIOS/BMC/SEL
Validated parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS metadata and approved high-level log metadata only; do not execute raw memory/I/O access based solely on the enum.
Do not clear, write or inject event records and do not change firmware.
Preserve the raw enum and full method/address pair; an address has different meaning under different access methods.
Do not assume Type 15 maps to BMC SEL without explicit platform evidence.
Stop on unknown/vendor enum, incoherent address/layout, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode the access enum, validate method/address/layout coherence against the approved map and compare pre/post reboot.
Do not dereference raw addresses, mutate logs or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the method-specific implementation/address map and safe boundary.
Approve reboot/recovery, authorize any separate raw-access validation if necessary and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but the decoded fragment cannot validate raw enum, method-specific address semantics or implementation/layout coherence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 15 data and compare the raw access enum together with Access Method Address, offsets, status and formats; do not use the advertised mechanism in this case.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Access Method scope, Type 15 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing/raw access is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode the version-aware access enum, interpret the access-method address only under that enum and validate the pair against the approved log implementation/layout across reboot using read-only metadata.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 15 System Event Log implementations.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, log implementation and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 15 Access Method and Access Method Address semantics, approved platform log architecture and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw enum/address/layout coherence and an explicit prohibition on unapproved dereference.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; detects a valid-looking enum paired with an invalid address or implementation while avoiding unsafe access.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Method-specific address and platform log map.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Metadata correctness does not prove the advertised raw access mechanism works or is safe to invoke from the OS.

project_override_considerations: A project may select another defined method, but must version the matching address/layout and provide a separate approved access test if functional proof is required; it cannot infer permission from the field value.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/firmware identity and method/address/log implementation map
Complete pre-reboot Type 15 record with raw/decoded method, address, area/offset/status/format fields
Method-address-layout coherence result and optional approved high-level log correlation
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot metadata diff without clearing/accessing raw storage

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Access Method metadata intent is coherent; generic log clearing is excluded as nonessential under locked safety policy.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The enum/address tuple can be safely read and compared without executing the access method; missing project mapping is readiness.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw enum/address pairing, implementation identity and no-dereference boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains raw-access safety while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification for metadata validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates any future functional access test and formal engineer verdict from this case's capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a decoded enum label from granting implicit permission to touch raw memory/I/O and catches method-address mismatches.
independent_technical_reasoning: Access Method is a structured enum whose coherence with adjacent metadata is deterministically testable without invoking the underlying mechanism.
